name: paygate-sandbox
description: Sandbox that emulates the 2C2P and Omise payment APIs, so an integration can be tested against declines, timeouts and duplicate callbacks on demand. Unofficial.

paragraphs: A self-hosted sandbox that emulates the 2C2P and Omise payment APIs, so you can test an integration against every response a gateway can return — including the ones you cannot trigger on demand in a real staging environment.

Point your backend at it instead of the provider, then drive the transaction: settle it, decline it with a specific issuer code, make an inquiry time out, or deliver the same webhook twice out of order. A built-in callback inspector captures what your webhook would have received, so the whole request → callback loop stays in one place.
Try it: paygate-sandbox.vercel.app — sign in with demo for sample payments of your own.
